title: ESM Metagenomic Atlas: over 600 million protein structures
summary: Meta AI published predicted structures for almost the entire MGnify90 database (over 600 million), generated in about two weeks on roughly 2,000 GPUs with a 15-billion-parameter language model, up to 60 times faster than previous methods. These are predictions, and high-confidence structures are a much smaller subset.

evidence.tested: The preprint reports structure prediction up to 60 times faster while maintaining accuracy versus state-of-the-art methods and an atlas of 617 million structures; the blog describes no experimental checks.
evidence.unknown: The blog lists no limitations and notes some sequences fold into disordered forms; high-confidence predictions are a subset.
evidence.ai_role: Language model (15B parameters) predicted protein structures from sequence.
